notes.title: Clawed Cult in the Made in Brazil Sale 🔮🐱
notes.content:
The Call of the Cult! 

A message from the shadows (and feline paws) has arrived: From today until [b]March 4th[/b], Clawed Cult is part of the Made in Brazil Sale! An event featuring incredible Brazilian games 🔥

[b]What awaits you in Clawed Cult?[/b]

🔄 Reverse bullet hell 
🐾 Cute yet creepy creatures, each with unique abilities
🗺️ Procedurally generated maps 
🕷️ Defeat bosses and summon them to fight for you
👁️ Hordes of enemies 
📜 A Lovecraftian world shrouded in mystery
🎶 A soundtrack that adapts to the action

See you in the next wave!

notes.title: Demo Launch Transmission!
notes.content:
Meowdy!

🫣Clawed Cult demo is live right now! Go check it out and play it. 

It's your chance to play Clawed Cult for free during the Bullet Heaven Fest! We're going to remove the demo after the Fest so we can bring you a fresh one on the next update, so this is the right time to enjoy our game.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Dev Plays Clawed Cult - No Commentary
notes.content:
Meowdy!

This is our first gameplay transmission for Clawed Cult!

The game version played during the gameplay is alpha and do not represent the final product. Soon you will be able to play it too!

Join the Cult!
